subject: SF Community Roundtable — promo codes & trial allocation
messages:
From: Maria Diaz <maria.diaz@ndustria.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Promo code request for SF Community Roundtable

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for chatting earlier — Ndustria is finalizing the attendee perks for the SF Community Roundtable on Aug 20 and we'd love to offer Redwood trial access to attendees. Can you help with: 50 promo codes, each redeemable for a 90-day trial? We'll distribute via our attendee email list.

A few questions:
- Can codes be pre-generated in a CSV we can drop into our mailer?
- Do codes auto-expire after X days from issue or can we set a calendar expiration (we'd like them to expire Oct 18)?
- Any usage caps we should communicate (tokens, rate limits)?

Attendee list attached for headcount.

Thanks — excited to partner on this.

— Maria
Maria Diaz
Partnerships & Events, Ndustria
attachments: attendee_list.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Diaz <maria.diaz@ndustria.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo code request for SF Community Roundtable

Hi Maria — thanks, and great to hear the event is coming together. Looping in Vivek (partnerships) and Laura (partners ops) to confirm allocation and tracking. Initial thoughts below:

- We can generate a CSV of 50 single-use promo codes and set calendar expiration to 2026-10-18.
- Standard trial = 90 days. We can optionally set a token cap if you'd prefer a lightweight experience.
- We will provide a HubSpot-friendly CSV (code, redemption URL, expiration, note) that you can import into your mailer.

Action items I need from internal: Vivek/Laura — can we approve 50 full 90-day trials for this partner promotion? I have attached a quick clause draft for tracking/attribution.

Maria — once internal signoff is complete I'll send the final CSV and redemption instructions.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partner Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed_promo_clause.docx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo code request for SF Community Roundtable

Thanks for the ping. Quick cost check and suggestion:

- 50 full 90-day trials is OK from a marketing budget perspective but let's be conservative on open-ended consumption. Recommend splitting: 30 full trials (unlimited within normal T&Cs) + 20 limited trials (90 days but capped at 50k tokens) to avoid unexpected spend.
- Estimated spend impact (very rough): see attached cost estimate.

If that sounds reasonable I can flag finance to prepare a $1k marketing credit for the campaign and we can authorize code generation.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Growth & Partnerships
attachments: cost-estimate.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo code request for SF Community Roundtable

Approving per Vivek's recommendation: 30 full 90-day trials + 20 limited 50k-token trials. Budget approved (allocate from Q3 marketing partner line, cap $1,000).

Please:
- Soojin, generate the CSV using the attached promo_code_template.csv format (include redemption URL + HubSpot tracking params).
- I'll create the HubSpot campaign record and ask finance to issue the credit; include deal id DEAL-8972 in the record.

I'll also attach our standard event SLA and tracking expectations for the partner. Once you have the final CSV, I will sign off and you can distribute to Ndustria.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: promo_code_template.csv, event_sla.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Diaz <maria.diaz@ndustria.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized promo codes & redemption instructions — SF Roundtable

Hi Maria — thanks for waiting. We're all set: attached is a CSV with 50 codes (30 full 90-day trials, 20 90-day with 50k token cap). Key details below: 

- Expiration (calendar): 2026-10-18
- Redemption URL: https://app.redwood.com/promo/redeem (codes are single-use)
- HubSpot tracking: Please append utm_campaign=ndustria_sf_roundtable to your mailer links; I included a column in the CSV with the full tracking URL.
- Delivery: send codes directly to attendees from events@ndustria.com. Do not repost publicly.

Attachments: promo_50_codes.csv, event_sla.pdf

If you want us to run the distribution from our side (we can white-label), we can discuss a simple co-send. Otherwise these are ready to import.

Best of luck with the event — let us know how the turnout looks and we can set an intro to a CSM for any onboarding questions.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partner Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: promo_50_codes.csv, event_sla.pdf
